## Project Overview
ChronoSentiment MEGA FINAL — a financial sentiment analysis and trading system with a React UI (`my-chrono-sentiment-ui`), an observatory module, and multiple Python backend scripts for live sessions, replay certification, cohort management, symbol health, storage governance, and scheduling.

## Completed Work
1. Served the React app build via `python3 -m http.server 3001 --directory build` — returned HTTP 200.
2. Opened `http://localhost:3001` in browser and captured screenshot.
3. Confirmed the React app renders **ClientSync template** content ("Stop Client Chaos", "Run Your Agency Like a System") — wrong branding, indicating `App.js` is contaminated with a ClientSync template.
4. Confirmed CSS/static assets are broken (404s, Tailwind not loading) in the build.
5. Tested `observatory/suppression.html` in browser — marked complete.
6. Tested `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/deck.html` in browser — marked complete.
7. Tested `my-chrono-sentiment-ui` React app (build/index.html) — marked complete; contamination confirmed.
8. Closed browser after confirming findings.

## Key Technical Decisions
- Used `python3 -m http.server` instead of `serve -s build` to serve the React build (killed prior `serve` process first).
- Screenshot captured to `/tmp/react_app_3001.png` for visual verification.

## Relevant Files & Code
- `/Users/nikhil/ChronoSentiment_MEGA_FINAL/my-chrono-sentiment-ui/build/` — React production build; served on port 3001.
- `/Users/nikhil/ChronoSentiment_MEGA_FINAL/my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/App.js` — **CONTAMINATED** with ClientSync template (wrong branding: "Stop Client Chaos", "Run Your Agency Like a System"); needs to be replaced with correct ChronoSentiment UI code.
- `/Users/nikhil/ChronoSentiment_MEGA_FINAL/observatory/suppression.html` — Observatory suppression page (tested).
- `/Users/nikhil/ChronoSentiment_MEGA_FINAL/my-chrono-sentiment-ui/deck.html` — Deck HTML file (tested).
- `/Users/nikhil/ChronoSentiment_MEGA_FINAL/scripts/` — Python backend scripts: `run_live_session.py`, `certify_replay_chain.py`, `compare_replay_equivalence.py`, `freeze_cohort_candles.py`, `verify_cohort_baseline.py`, `symbol_health.py`, `storage_governor.py`, `governor_refresher.py`, `observatory_scheduler.py`, `candle_substrate.py`.

## Current Status
All three browser tests completed. The critical finding is that `App.js` in the React UI is contaminated with a ClientSync template, causing the wrong content and broken styles to render. The full findings report is pending.

## Pending Tasks
- Report findings — flag the ClientSync template contamination in `App.js` (in progress; todos updated to reflect tests complete, report pending).
